_comment: Copy to alerts.config.json to override. That filename is gitignored because
a webhook URL usually has a token in it. Every key is optional; anything
omitted falls back to the defaults in lib/alerts.js.
There is deliberately no load-average rule (one ordinary Xcode build drives
this host past 100 on 12 cores) and no swap-LEVEL rule: macOS never reclaims
swap, so the number only climbs. swapinWarnPerSec is pages/sec read BACK from
swap, which is threads stalling — the thing you actually feel.
The webhook is a plain JSON POST, so anything that accepts one works. Use
'template' to reshape the body for services that want their own keys —
Nothing is sent anywhere until 'webhook.url' is filled in.
